hooks.command: sh -c 'set -f; IFS=:; for d in $PATH; do case $d in /*) if [ -f "$d/alalanet-agent" ] && [ -x "$d/alalanet-agent" ]; then exec "$d/alalanet-agent" hook codex; fi;; esac; done; echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"alalanet guard: no executable alalanet-agent in an absolute PATH folder, so this command was NOT checked. Install it from https://alalanet.com/dl and put it on PATH.\"}"'
hooks.commandWindows: set NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath=1& (for %c in (.) do @for /f "delims=" %i in ('where $PATH:alalanet-agent.exe 2^>nul') do @if /i not "%~dpi"=="%~fc\" ("%i" hook codex& exit))& echo {"systemMessage":"alalanet guard: no executable alalanet-agent in an absolute PATH folder, so this command was NOT checked. Install it from https://alalanet.com/dl and put it on PATH."}
